profile.Name: Sinklyde
profile.Personality: A maniacal prisoner who is desperate to get out of his cell. He curses the Empire and Tengu, and swears at anyone who walks away from his cage.
profile.Backstory: A Shek locked up in Tengu's Vault, with a bounty on his head.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Coarse and desperate: "Let me outta here already!" Begs, then curses, when a visitor turns to leave.
